gex_confirm.caveat: Dealer-gamma confirmer — context for HOW the next move behaves, not a name pick. Dealer sign is an assumption (fragile for single names) and the feed is delayed EOD. It can only lower conviction, never create a buy.
gex_confirm.caveat_zh: 做市商 Gamma 确认器 — 用于判断下一步波动的“方式”，并非选股。做市商方向为假设（对个股较脆弱），数据为延迟收盘。它只能降低信心，绝不制造买入信号。

vol_squeeze.caveat: Volatility is already elevated — realized vol sits in the top fifth of the past year, so the move is underway, not loading. This is the opposite of a coiled squeeze: the quiet entry is already gone. A late / heads-up read, never a standalone signal.
vol_squeeze.caveat_zh: 波动率已处于高位 — 实现波动率位于过去一年前五分之一，行情已在进行，而非蓄势。这与压缩蓄势相反：安静的入场点已过。属偏晚的提示读数，绝非独立信号。

iv_spread_confirm.label: Options lean down

reasons.en: puts richer than calls by -2.2 vol pts vs peers — protection strongly bid
reasons.zh: 看跌比看涨贵 -2.2 个波动点（相对同业） — 保护性看跌被大力买入

iv_spread_confirm.caveat: Cremers-Weinbaum call−put IV spread (matched strikes, ~30d, OI-weighted). Calls richer than puts = informed bullish lean; puts richer = protection bid. A CROSS-SECTIONAL context read — dividends/borrow can bias the level, the feed is delayed EOD, and it is DISPLAY-ONLY until the forward-IC gate validates. It can amplify or caution a long the price thesis already likes, never create a buy.
iv_spread_confirm.caveat_zh: Cremers-Weinbaum 看涨−看跌隐含波动率价差（同行权价配对，约30天，按未平仓量加权）。看涨比看跌更贵 = 知情资金偏多；看跌更贵 = 买入保护。这是横截面参考读数 — 股息/借券成本会扰动水平，数据为延迟收盘，且在前瞻IC验证通过前仅作展示。它只能放大或警示价格逻辑本已看好的多头，绝不制造买入信号。

Key indications include obesity, type 2 diabetes, and cardiovascular outcomes. Recent developments include positive Phase III results for retatrutide, survodutide, and other dual/triple agonists from major pharmaceutical companies.

The platform enables investors to build strategies using tokenized equities with DeFi composability, with over 100,000 traders already active. Permissionless stock market cap has grown 10x this year to exceed $3 billion.

top.title: SHAREHOLDER ALERT: Bronstein Gewirtz & Grossman, LLC Announces Class Action Against Webull Corporation (NASDAQ: BULL) — Investors Who Suffered Losses Are Encouraged to Contact the Firm
top.summary: A class action lawsuit has been filed against Webull Corporation (NASDAQ: BULL) alleging that the company made false and misleading statements about its operations. The complaint claims Webull misrepresented its independence from China, stating that its software development, data pipelines, and core engineering actually depend on PRC-based personnel and infrastructure, contrary to claims that principal operations were U.S.-based. The lead plaintiff deadline is December 7, 2026.

top.title: CCB SHAREHOLDER NOTICE: Coastal Financial Corporation Investors with Substantial Losses Have Opportunity to Lead the CCV Class Action Lawsuit – Hagens Berman
top.summary: Hagens Berman is seeking lead plaintiffs for a federal securities class action against Coastal Financial Corporation (CCB) over allegations that the company misled investors about risk management and credit quality in its Banking-as-a-Service segment. The company reported a surprise $42.1 million quarterly loss driven by $68.8 million in credit expenses from a single partner, causing the stock to plummet 43.5% on July 30, 2026. The lead plaintiff deadline is December 1, 2026.

top.title: Kaplan Fox Notifies Investors of Duolingo, Inc. (NASDAQ: DUOL) of a Securities Fraud Class Action Deadline on December 7, 2026
top.summary: Kaplan Fox has filed securities class action lawsuits against Duolingo, The Ensign Group, and Coastal Financial Corporation, alleging false and misleading statements to investors. Duolingo faces allegations of concealing negative impacts of increased ad volume and AI-generated content on user growth, with significant stock price drops following disappointing financial results. The lead plaintiff deadline is December 7, 2026 for Duolingo and Ensign Group, and December 1, 2026 for Coastal Financial.

top.title: SHAREHOLDER ALERT: Bronstein Gewirtz & Grossman, LLC Announces Class Action Against Honeywell Aerospace, Inc. (NASDAQ: HONA) — Investors Who Suffered Losses Are Encouraged to Contact the Firm
top.summary: Law firm Bronstein Gewirtz & Grossman has filed class action lawsuits against Honeywell Aerospace (HONA) for alleged securities fraud, claiming the company made materially false statements and failed to disclose supplier constraints, cybersecurity investigation issues, and their impact on sales and profitability. The lead plaintiff deadline is November 23, 2026. Similar class actions have also been filed against Netcapital (NCPL) and Coastal Financial Corporation (CCB).

top.title: SHAREHOLDER ALERT: Bronstein Gewirtz & Grossman, LLC Announces Class Action Against Endava plc (NYSE: DAVA) — Investors Who Suffered Losses Are Encouraged to Contact the Firm
top.summary: Law firm Bronstein Gewirtz & Grossman has filed class action lawsuits against Endava plc, Netcapital Inc., and Coastal Financial Corporation, alleging securities fraud and violations of federal securities laws. Endava investors who purchased securities between September 4, 2025 and September 21, 2026 are eligible to join the case, with a lead plaintiff deadline of November 30, 2026. The complaints allege false statements regarding accounting treatments, delayed financial results, and ineffective internal controls.

iv_spread_confirm.caveat: Cremers-Weinbaum call−put IV spread (matched strikes, ~30d, OI-weighted). Calls richer than puts = informed bullish lean; puts richer = protection bid. A CROSS-SECTIONAL context read — dividends/borrow can bias the level, the feed is delayed EOD, and it is DISPLAY-ONLY until the forward-IC gate validates. It can amplify or caution a long the price thesis already likes, never create a buy.
iv_spread_confirm.caveat_zh: Cremers-Weinbaum 看涨−看跌隐含波动率价差（同行权价配对，约30天，按未平仓量加权）。看涨比看跌更贵 = 知情资金偏多；看跌更贵 = 买入保护。这是横截面参考读数 — 股息/借券成本会扰动水平，数据为延迟收盘，且在前瞻IC验证通过前仅作展示。它只能放大或警示价格逻辑本已看好的多头，绝不制造买入信号。

top.title: La plupart des entreprises prévoient d’adopter une stratégie d’IA multi-modèles, alors que près de six sur dix ont subi des coûts liés à l’IA significativement supérieurs aux prévisions
top.summary: A Capgemini study reveals that 59% of enterprises have experienced AI costs significantly higher than expected, with spending exceeding budgets by an average of 24%. Only one-third of leaders can confidently estimate indirect AI costs like human supervision and content rework. Most companies cannot directly link AI spending to business value, with only 20% calculating AI Yield. Over 60% of executives plan to adopt multi-model AI strategies within a year to optimize costs and performance.

top.title: Most organizations plan to adopt a multi-model AI strategy, as nearly six in ten faced significantly higher AI costs than expected
top.summary: A Capgemini survey of 500 CXO-level executives reveals that 59% of organizations experienced significantly higher AI costs than expected, with spending averaging 24% above budget. Only 56% are confident in forecasting future AI costs. In response, organizations are adopting multi-model strategies and focusing on AI Yield metrics to better align spending with business outcomes, though only one in five currently calculates this metric.

top.summary: CVRx, Inc. faces a class action lawsuit alleging the medical device company misled investors about illegal sales practices, including improper marketing of Barostim, kickbacks, and false claims to government health insurance programs in violation of the false Claims Act and Anti-Kickback Statute. The company's stock dropped 60% on August 6, 2026, following disclosure of a Department of Justice civil investigative demand and weak sales force productivity. Investors who purchased CVRx stock between July 25, 2023 and August 6, 2026 may be eligible to participate in the lawsuit.

gex_confirm.caveat_zh: 做市商 Gamma 确认器 — 用于判断下一步波动的“方式”，并非选股。做市商方向为假设（对个股较脆弱），数据为延迟收盘。它只能降低信心，绝不制造买入信号。

vol_squeeze.caveat: Volatility is already elevated — realized vol sits in the top fifth of the past year, so the move is underway, not loading. This is the opposite of a coiled squeeze: the quiet entry is already gone. A late / heads-up read, never a standalone signal.
vol_squeeze.caveat_zh: 波动率已处于高位 — 实现波动率位于过去一年前五分之一，行情已在进行，而非蓄势。这与压缩蓄势相反：安静的入场点已过。属偏晚的提示读数，绝非独立信号。

iv_spread_confirm.label: Options lean up

iv_spread_confirm.caveat: Cremers-Weinbaum call−put IV spread (matched strikes, ~30d, OI-weighted). Calls richer than puts = informed bullish lean; puts richer = protection bid. A CROSS-SECTIONAL context read — dividends/borrow can bias the level, the feed is delayed EOD, and it is DISPLAY-ONLY until the forward-IC gate validates. It can amplify or caution a long the price thesis already likes, never create a buy.
iv_spread_confirm.caveat_zh: Cremers-Weinbaum 看涨−看跌隐含波动率价差（同行权价配对，约30天，按未平仓量加权）。看涨比看跌更贵 = 知情资金偏多；看跌更贵 = 买入保护。这是横截面参考读数 — 股息/借券成本会扰动水平，数据为延迟收盘，且在前瞻IC验证通过前仅作展示。它只能放大或警示价格逻辑本已看好的多头，绝不制造买入信号。

top.summary: Danone has successfully completed its acquisition of MADE Group, an Australia-based healthy nutrition company with sales exceeding €300 million. The acquisition strengthens Danone's position in the fast-growing Asia Pacific health and wellness market, combining MADE's innovation capabilities and marketing expertise with Danone's scale and scientific expertise.

top.title: Danone finalise l’acquisition de MADE Group, renforçant ainsi sa présence dans les segments en forte croissance de la nutrition saine en Asie-Pacifique
top.summary: Danone has successfully completed the acquisition of MADE Group, an Australian health-focused food and beverage company with strong growth in protein drinks, gut health yogurts, and coconut products. MADE Group, which generated over €300 million in annual revenue, has a significant presence in Australia, New Zealand, and Southeast Asia. The acquisition strengthens Danone's EDP (Essential Dairy and Plant-based) business in the Asia-Pacific region by combining MADE's entrepreneurial culture, marketing expertise, and distribution capabilities with Danone's scale and scientific leadership.

top.title: Randomized Study of Non-Invasive Autonomic Neuromodulation for Long COVID Published Online in Neuromodulation
top.summary: electroCore and Sonocea published results from a randomized controlled trial evaluating non-invasive neuromodulation technologies for Long COVID treatment. The study of 250 participants showed improvements in fatigue, cognition, sleep, and mental health symptoms across active intervention groups compared to monitoring-only controls, with depressive symptoms decreasing 31-34% and PTSD symptoms reducing 39% with combined therapy. However, the open-label design without sham control and reliance on patient-reported outcomes limit the findings, which are considered hypothesis-generating and warrant confirmation in larger, sham-controlled studies.

top.summary: Eramet, a global metals extraction and processing company, announced a €500 million rights issue to strengthen its balance sheet and reduce debt. The French State's APE will subscribe for approximately 64% of the issue, representing €322 million, to strengthen its strategic stake while maintaining voting rights below 49%.

top.title: LEQEMBI® Pen (Subcutaneous Formulation of LEQEMBI®) Now Available in Japan for Patients with Early Alzheimer’s Disease
top.summary: Eisai and Biogen announced the launch of LEQEMBI Pen, a subcutaneous autoinjector formulation of lecanemab, in Japan on November 12, 2026. The new formulation enables once-weekly self-administration or administration by a care partner, offering greater flexibility compared to the existing intravenous treatment every two weeks. Japan is the second country to launch this subcutaneous formulation following the United States.

Technological advancements in valve platforms and delivery systems are creating growth opportunities, with Asia Pacific emerging as the fastest-growing region.

top.title: Mortgage Rates Decline for Fourth Consecutive Week to 7.11%
top.summary: Freddie Mac reported that 30-year fixed-rate mortgages averaged 7.11% as of November 12, 2026, down from 7.18% the previous week. The 15-year FRM averaged 6.45%, down from 6.57%. While rates have declined to their lowest level in seven weeks, they remain higher than a year ago when the 30-year FRM averaged 6.24%.

top.title: Existing-Home Sales Decreased 5.5% in October, According to NAR Report
top.summary: Existing-home sales fell 5.5% month-over-month and 8.8% year-over-year in October 2026, reaching their lowest level since August 2010. The decline is attributed to mortgage rates climbing to their highest levels since 2000, now at 7.33% for a 30-year fixed-rate mortgage. Despite the sales slowdown, median home prices increased 0.4% year-over-year to $416,700, and housing inventory rose 4.6% from the prior year.

Freelancers report significantly more control over schedules and fewer meetings compared to traditional employees.

Investors who purchased securities between October 16, 2024 and December 29, 2025 may be eligible to recover losses, with a lead plaintiff deadline of December 14, 2026.

top.summary: DelveInsight released a comprehensive competitive landscape report on BCMA-targeted therapies, analyzing 100+ pipeline drugs across 80+ companies. The report highlights recent clinical advances including Pfizer's positive Phase III results for ELREXFIO, AbbVie's BLA submission for etentamig, and Gilead's $7.8 billion acquisition of Arcellx to gain control of anito-cel. Key challenges include treatment resistance, relapse, and manufacturing complexity, while the pipeline focuses on improving durability, safety, and accessibility through next-generation approaches.

top.title: Global Injectables Market is Anticipated to Surpass USD 1 Trillion Mark by 2034 | DelveInsight
top.summary: The global injectables market is projected to grow from USD 765 billion in 2025 to USD 1.6 trillion by 2034, with a CAGR of approximately 9%. Growth is driven by rising adoption of biologics, biosimilars, GLP-1 therapies, and advances in drug-delivery technologies like prefilled syringes and auto-injectors. North America leads with 39% market share, while Asia-Pacific represents the fastest-expanding region. Key developments include West Pharmaceutical Services' Dublin expansion and Fresenius Kabi's U.S. manufacturing collaboration.

Key indications include obesity, type 2 diabetes, and cardiovascular outcomes. Recent developments include positive Phase III results for retatrutide, survodutide, and other dual/triple agonists from major pharmaceutical companies.

top.title: Deadline Alert: Netcapital Inc. Investors Have Until December 7, 2026 to Seek Lead Plaintiff Role in Securities Fraud Class Action, Glancy Prongay Wolke & Rotter LLP Reminds Investors
top.summary: Netcapital Inc. investors have until December 7, 2026 to seek lead plaintiff status in a securities fraud class action. The SEC alleged the company fraudulently overstated revenue by approximately 345% through sham consulting agreements from October 2021 to January 2024, causing significant stock price declines following disclosure announcements in August and September 2026.

top.title: SHAREHOLDER ALERT: Bronstein Gewirtz & Grossman, LLC Announces Class Action Against Honeywell Aerospace, Inc. (NASDAQ: HONA) — Investors Who Suffered Losses Are Encouraged to Contact the Firm
top.summary: Law firm Bronstein Gewirtz & Grossman has filed class action lawsuits against Honeywell Aerospace (HONA) for alleged securities fraud, claiming the company made materially false statements and failed to disclose supplier constraints, cybersecurity investigation issues, and their impact on sales and profitability. The lead plaintiff deadline is November 23, 2026. Similar class actions have also been filed against Netcapital (NCPL) and Coastal Financial Corporation (CCB).

top.title: SHAREHOLDER ALERT: Bronstein Gewirtz & Grossman, LLC Announces Class Action Against Endava plc (NYSE: DAVA) — Investors Who Suffered Losses Are Encouraged to Contact the Firm
top.summary: Law firm Bronstein Gewirtz & Grossman has filed class action lawsuits against Endava plc, Netcapital Inc., and Coastal Financial Corporation, alleging securities fraud and violations of federal securities laws. Endava investors who purchased securities between September 4, 2025 and September 21, 2026 are eligible to join the case, with a lead plaintiff deadline of November 30, 2026. The complaints allege false statements regarding accounting treatments, delayed financial results, and ineffective internal controls.

top.title: SHAREHOLDER ALERT: Bronstein Gewirtz & Grossman, LLC Announces Class Action Against Netcapital Inc. (NASDAQ: NCPL) — Investors Who Suffered Losses Are Encouraged to Contact the Firm
top.summary: A class action lawsuit has been filed against Netcapital Inc. alleging securities fraud, including improper revenue recognition from sham consulting agreements, backdated and forged contracts, undisclosed related-party transactions, and false Sarbanes-Oxley certifications. Investors who purchased NCPL securities between December 15, 2021 and September 3, 2026 may be eligible to recover losses, with a lead plaintiff deadline of December 7, 2026.

vol_squeeze.caveat_zh: 波动率已处于高位 — 实现波动率位于过去一年前五分之一，行情已在进行，而非蓄势。这与压缩蓄势相反：安静的入场点已过。属偏晚的提示读数，绝非独立信号。

reasons.en: calls richer than puts by +3.2 vol pts vs peers — strong informed bullish lean
reasons.zh: 看涨比看跌贵 +3.2 个波动点（相对同业） — 知情资金强烈偏多

iv_spread_confirm.caveat: Cremers-Weinbaum call−put IV spread (matched strikes, ~30d, OI-weighted). Calls richer than puts = informed bullish lean; puts richer = protection bid. A CROSS-SECTIONAL context read — dividends/borrow can bias the level, the feed is delayed EOD, and it is DISPLAY-ONLY until the forward-IC gate validates. It can amplify or caution a long the price thesis already likes, never create a buy.
iv_spread_confirm.caveat_zh: Cremers-Weinbaum 看涨−看跌隐含波动率价差（同行权价配对，约30天，按未平仓量加权）。看涨比看跌更贵 = 知情资金偏多；看跌更贵 = 买入保护。这是横截面参考读数 — 股息/借券成本会扰动水平，数据为延迟收盘，且在前瞻IC验证通过前仅作展示。它只能放大或警示价格逻辑本已看好的多头，绝不制造买入信号。

top.summary: Intellia Therapeutics announced positive clinical data for lonvo-z, its one-time CRISPR gene editing treatment for hereditary angioedema (HAE), presented at ACAAI 2026. Key trends include generative AI for molecule design, multimodal AI for biological data analysis, and growing focus on AI model validation.

top.title: GLP-1 RAs & Incretin-based Therapies Competitive Landscape Analysis: Key Developments by 200+ Companies Shaping the Treatment Landscape | DelveInsight
top.summary: DelveInsight released a comprehensive competitive landscape report on GLP-1 receptor agonists and incretin-based therapies, covering 200+ pipeline drugs from 180+ active players. Key indications include obesity, type 2 diabetes, and cardiovascular outcomes. Recent developments include positive Phase III results for retatrutide, survodutide, and other dual/triple agonists from major pharmaceutical companies.

top.title: SHAREHOLDER ALERT: Bronstein Gewirtz & Grossman, LLC Announces Class Action Against O-I Glass, Inc. (NYSE: OI) — Investors Who Suffered Losses Are Encouraged to Contact the Firm
top.summary: A class action lawsuit has been filed against O-I Glass, Inc. (NYSE: OI) alleging that the company made false and misleading statements regarding its Fit to Win cost-saving program. The complaint claims the company failed to disclose delays in achieving targeted savings, higher-than-expected expenses, operational disruptions, and competitive pressures affecting European operations. Investors who purchased OI securities between March 14, 2025 and July 28, 2026 may be eligible to recover losses, with a lead plaintiff deadline of December 28, 2026.

top.title: BCMA Targeted Therapies Competitive Landscape Analysis: 100+ Pipeline Therapies Driving Innovation in Therapeutics Segment | DelveInsight
top.summary: DelveInsight released a comprehensive competitive landscape report on BCMA-targeted therapies, analyzing 100+ pipeline drugs across 80+ companies. The report highlights recent clinical advances including Pfizer's positive Phase III results for ELREXFIO, AbbVie's BLA submission for etentamig, and Gilead's $7.8 billion acquisition of Arcellx to gain control of anito-cel. Key challenges include treatment resistance, relapse, and manufacturing complexity, while the pipeline focuses on improving durability, safety, and accessibility through next-generation approaches.

top.title: GLP-1 RAs & Incretin-based Therapies Competitive Landscape Analysis: Key Developments by 200+ Companies Shaping the Treatment Landscape | DelveInsight
top.summary: DelveInsight released a comprehensive competitive landscape report on GLP-1 receptor agonists and incretin-based therapies, covering 200+ pipeline drugs from 180+ active players. The report highlights approved drugs like MOUNJARO (tirzepatide) and OZEMPIC (semaglutide), with 30+ therapies in late-stage development and 60+ in mid/early stages. Key indications include obesity, type 2 diabetes, and cardiovascular outcomes. Recent developments include positive Phase III results for retatrutide, survodutide, and other dual/triple agonists from major pharmaceutical companies.

top.title: Global Injectables Market is Anticipated to Surpass USD 1 Trillion Mark by 2034 | DelveInsight
top.summary: The global injectables market is projected to grow from USD 765 billion in 2025 to USD 1.6 trillion by 2034, with a CAGR of approximately 9%. Growth is driven by rising adoption of biologics, biosimilars, GLP-1 therapies, and advances in drug-delivery technologies like prefilled syringes and auto-injectors. North America leads with 39% market share, while Asia-Pacific represents the fastest-expanding region. Key developments include West Pharmaceutical Services' Dublin expansion and Fresenius Kabi's U.S. manufacturing collaboration.

reasons.en: negative-gamma tape — dealer hedging amplifies the move (fuel for a breakout)

reasons.en: short-gamma expansion — realized vol elevated, no suppressive band

gex_confirm.caveat: Dealer-gamma confirmer — context for HOW the next move behaves, not a name pick. Dealer sign is an assumption (fragile for single names) and the feed is delayed EOD. It can only lower conviction, never create a buy.
gex_confirm.caveat_zh: 做市商 Gamma 确认器 — 用于判断下一步波动的“方式”，并非选股。做市商方向为假设（对个股较脆弱），数据为延迟收盘。它只能降低信心，绝不制造买入信号。

vol_squeeze.caveat: Volatility is already elevated — realized vol sits in the top fifth of the past year, so the move is underway, not loading. This is the opposite of a coiled squeeze: the quiet entry is already gone. A late / heads-up read, never a standalone signal.
vol_squeeze.caveat_zh: 波动率已处于高位 — 实现波动率位于过去一年前五分之一，行情已在进行，而非蓄势。这与压缩蓄势相反：安静的入场点已过。属偏晚的提示读数，绝非独立信号。

iv_spread_confirm.label: Options lean down

reasons.en: puts richer than calls by -2.8 vol pts vs peers — protection strongly bid
reasons.zh: 看跌比看涨贵 -2.8 个波动点（相对同业） — 保护性看跌被大力买入

iv_spread_confirm.caveat: Cremers-Weinbaum call−put IV spread (matched strikes, ~30d, OI-weighted). Calls richer than puts = informed bullish lean; puts richer = protection bid. A CROSS-SECTIONAL context read — dividends/borrow can bias the level, the feed is delayed EOD, and it is DISPLAY-ONLY until the forward-IC gate validates. It can amplify or caution a long the price thesis already likes, never create a buy.
iv_spread_confirm.caveat_zh: Cremers-Weinbaum 看涨−看跌隐含波动率价差（同行权价配对，约30天，按未平仓量加权）。看涨比看跌更贵 = 知情资金偏多；看跌更贵 = 买入保护。这是横截面参考读数 — 股息/借券成本会扰动水平，数据为延迟收盘，且在前瞻IC验证通过前仅作展示。它只能放大或警示价格逻辑本已看好的多头，绝不制造买入信号。

top.title: AI in Drug Discovery Market to Reach USD 15,536.2 Million by 2033 at 25.1% CAGR | Coherent Market Insights
top.summary: The global AI in drug discovery market is projected to grow from USD 3,240.0 million in 2026 to USD 15,536.2 million by 2033, with a CAGR of 25.1%. Growth is driven by increasing pharmaceutical investments in AI infrastructure, machine learning adoption, and collaborations between pharma companies and AI providers. North America leads with 51.6% market share, while Asia Pacific shows the fastest growth at 27.2% CAGR. Key trends include generative AI for molecule design, multimodal AI for biological data analysis, and growing focus on AI model validation.

Key indications include obesity, type 2 diabetes, and cardiovascular outcomes. Recent developments include positive Phase III results for retatrutide, survodutide, and other dual/triple agonists from major pharmaceutical companies.

North America leads with 51.6% market share, while Asia Pacific shows the fastest growth at 27.2% CAGR. Key trends include generative AI for molecule design, multimodal AI for biological data analysis, and growing focus on AI model validation.

iv_spread_confirm.caveat: Cremers-Weinbaum call−put IV spread (matched strikes, ~30d, OI-weighted). Calls richer than puts = informed bullish lean; puts richer = protection bid. iv_spread_confirm.caveat: Cremers-Weinbaum call−put IV spread (matched strikes, ~30d, OI-weighted). Calls richer than puts = informed bullish lean; puts richer = protection bid. iv_spread_confirm.caveat_zh: Cremers-Weinbaum 看涨−看跌隐含波动率价差（同行权价配对，约30天，按未平仓量加权）。看涨比看跌更贵 = 知情资金偏多；看跌更贵 = 买入保护。这是横截面参考读数 — 股息/借券成本会扰动水平，数据为延迟收盘，且在前瞻IC验证通过前仅作展示。它只能放大或警示价格逻辑本已看好的多头，绝不制造买入信号。

gex_confirm.caveat: Dealer-gamma confirmer — context for HOW the next move behaves, not a name pick. Dealer sign is an assumption (fragile for single names) and the feed is delayed EOD. It can only lower conviction, never create a buy.

vol_squeeze.caveat_zh: 波动率已处于高位 — 实现波动率位于过去一年前五分之一，行情已在进行，而非蓄势。这与压缩蓄势相反：安静的入场点已过。属偏晚的提示读数，绝非独立信号。

iv_spread_confirm.label: Options lean up

reasons.en: calls richer than puts by +19.1 vol pts vs peers — strong informed bullish lean
reasons.zh: 看涨比看跌贵 +19.1 个波动点（相对同业） — 知情资金强烈偏多

iv_spread_confirm.caveat: Cremers-Weinbaum call−put IV spread (matched strikes, ~30d, OI-weighted). Calls richer than puts = informed bullish lean; puts richer = protection bid. A CROSS-SECTIONAL context read — dividends/borrow can bias the level, the feed is delayed EOD, and it is DISPLAY-ONLY until the forward-IC gate validates. It can amplify or caution a long the price thesis already likes, never create a buy.
iv_spread_confirm.caveat_zh: Cremers-Weinbaum 看涨−看跌隐含波动率价差（同行权价配对，约30天，按未平仓量加权）。看涨比看跌更贵 = 知情资金偏多；看跌更贵 = 买入保护。这是横截面参考读数 — 股息/借券成本会扰动水平，数据为延迟收盘，且在前瞻IC验证通过前仅作展示。它只能放大或警示价格逻辑本已看好的多头，绝不制造买入信号。

top.summary: DelveInsight released a comprehensive competitive landscape report on GLP-1 receptor agonists and incretin-based therapies, covering 200+ pipeline drugs from 180+ active players. The report highlights approved drugs like MOUNJARO (tirzepatide) and OZEMPIC (semaglutide), with 30+ therapies in late-stage development and 60+ in mid/early stages. Key indications include obesity, type 2 diabetes, and cardiovascular outcomes. Recent developments include positive Phase III results for retatrutide, survodutide, and other dual/triple agonists from major pharmaceutical companies.

gex_confirm.caveat: Dealer-gamma confirmer — context for HOW the next move behaves, not a name pick. Dealer sign is an assumption (fragile for single names) and the feed is delayed EOD. It can only lower conviction, never create a buy.
gex_confirm.caveat_zh: 做市商 Gamma 确认器 — 用于判断下一步波动的“方式”，并非选股。做市商方向为假设（对个股较脆弱），数据为延迟收盘。它只能降低信心，绝不制造买入信号。

vol_squeeze.caveat: Volatility is already elevated — realized vol sits in the top fifth of the past year, so the move is underway, not loading. This is the opposite of a coiled squeeze: the quiet entry is already gone. A late / heads-up read, never a standalone signal.
vol_squeeze.caveat_zh: 波动率已处于高位 — 实现波动率位于过去一年前五分之一，行情已在进行，而非蓄势。这与压缩蓄势相反：安静的入场点已过。属偏晚的提示读数，绝非独立信号。

iv_spread_confirm.label: Options lean up

reasons.en: calls richer than puts by +13.3 vol pts vs peers — strong informed bullish lean
reasons.zh: 看涨比看跌贵 +13.3 个波动点（相对同业） — 知情资金强烈偏多

iv_spread_confirm.caveat: Cremers-Weinbaum call−put IV spread (matched strikes, ~30d, OI-weighted). Calls richer than puts = informed bullish lean; puts richer = protection bid. A CROSS-SECTIONAL context read — dividends/borrow can bias the level, the feed is delayed EOD, and it is DISPLAY-ONLY until the forward-IC gate validates. It can amplify or caution a long the price thesis already likes, never create a buy.
iv_spread_confirm.caveat_zh: Cremers-Weinbaum 看涨−看跌隐含波动率价差（同行权价配对，约30天，按未平仓量加权）。看涨比看跌更贵 = 知情资金偏多；看跌更贵 = 买入保护。这是横截面参考读数 — 股息/借券成本会扰动水平，数据为延迟收盘，且在前瞻IC验证通过前仅作展示。它只能放大或警示价格逻辑本已看好的多头，绝不制造买入信号。

top.title: Global Injectables Market is Anticipated to Surpass USD 1 Trillion Mark by 2034 | DelveInsight
top.summary: The global injectables market is projected to grow from USD 765 billion in 2025 to USD 1.6 trillion by 2034, with a CAGR of approximately 9%. Growth is driven by rising adoption of biologics, biosimilars, GLP-1 therapies, and advances in drug-delivery technologies like prefilled syringes and auto-injectors. North America leads with 39% market share, while Asia-Pacific represents the fastest-expanding region. Key developments include West Pharmaceutical Services' Dublin expansion and Fresenius Kabi's U.S. manufacturing collaboration.

The awards emphasize the effectiveness of law enforcement and private sector intelligence sharing.

top.title: Kaplan Fox Reminds Yiren Digital Ltd. (NYSE: YRD) Investors Seeking Recovery of the Lead Plaintiff Deadline on December 28, 2026
top.summary: Kaplan Fox has filed a class action lawsuit against Yiren Digital Ltd. on behalf of investors who purchased securities between April 29, 2026 and October 13, 2026. The lawsuit alleges that the company made false statements regarding its controlling shareholder CreditEase's financial distress. Yiren stock fell 14.44% on May 22, 2026 following news of CreditEase suspending payments on $4.4 billion in wealth management products, and fell another 44% on October 12, 2026 after a criminal investigation was opened into CreditEase and its CEO Ning Tang. The lead plaintiff deadline is December 28, 2026.
